detailed_description:
Realistic 9:16 Chinese homeware ecommerce photography with soft neutral daylight and readable product detail. Speech uses a bright, brisk Mandarin ecommerce delivery, crisp articulation, short natural phrase breaks and continuous narration across the editorial cut. The two sentences run from about 0.25 to 14.6 seconds at approximately 5.5 Chinese syllables per second.
[Shot 1] 0.0–7.8 seconds. A steady eye-level medium shot based on <Picture 1>. The presenter looks directly into the lens, opens her palm beside the upright mug and gives a small welcoming smile. <Subject 1> (S1) says: <d>[Chinese] 桌面想换个清爽风格，先看这只浅绿色杯子。杯身这一圈细竖纹，近看有层次，放在木桌上也很协调。</d>
[Shot 2] 7.8–15.08 seconds. At 7.8 seconds, cut to a tight three-quarter close-up based on <Picture 2>. The cup fills the center of the portrait frame. The camera makes a short controlled move past the vertical ribs, then settles on the rim and handle. The presenter continues off-screen. <Subject 1> (S1) continues in the same brisk voice: <d>[Chinese] 再看奶白色杯内和圆弧把手，外观细节都给你拍清楚，选杯子先把这些地方看明白。</d> The completed sentence leaves a brief natural breath at the ending. The final frame holds the same established product position.

overall_soundscape:
Close-recorded clear Mandarin speech over faint continuous indoor room tone. Short natural breaths separate phrases. The voice remains at a consistent loudness across the cut.
